notes: The catalogue queries Surendratīrtha as scribe/donor, but the quoted colophon names no persons, date or place. It contains only chapter-end formulas (adhyāya 100, fol. 343v, and adhyāya 85 on an extra folio numbered 259). Surendratīrtha may come from elsewhere in the manuscript, outside the quoted colophon, so it cannot be confirmed here.
